T3_about.h2: What MAGLUMI X6 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: MAGLUMI X6 is a fully automated Snibe CLIA analyzer for chemiluminescence immunoassay in laboratories with substantial testing workloads. It supports walk-away operation after loading and can form part of a modular configuration. Integration with a total laboratory automation system should be checked for each project.

items.text: Multiple X6 analyzers can be combined, or X6 can operate alongside other modules. This lets the laboratory plan a configuration around its testing workload.
Filtered disposable tips are designed to reduce cross-contamination between samples, according to the manufacturer. Individual reaction cups are heated from five sides.
Loading, unloading and status checks are performed from one side of the instrument. Wash solution can be prepared in automatic or manual mode.

testMenu.title: MAGLUMI CLIA test menu
testMenu.text: The menu spans hormones, tumor markers, infectious and cardiac markers, and other areas. Ask LabWell to confirm which individual assays are available in Ukraine.

items.q: What is the throughput of MAGLUMI X6?
items.a: MAGLUMI X6 delivers up to 450 tests per hour.

items.q: Which laboratories is MAGLUMI X6 designed for?
items.a: MAGLUMI X6 is designed for laboratories with substantial immunoassay workloads. The modular configuration should be selected for the needs of each project.

items.q: How many samples and reagents can be loaded?
items.a: The analyzer provides up to 112 sample positions and 30 reagent positions.

items.q: Which tests can MAGLUMI X6 perform?
items.a: The analyzer uses the MAGLUMI CLIA test menu; ask LabWell to confirm which individual assays are available in Ukraine.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains MAGLUMI X6 in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Snibe distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.
